what_it_shows: Decathlon UK All Sports A-Z: about 100 sports and activities (American Football to Yoga), including Camping, Hiking, Fishing split by style (carp, coarse and match, predator, sea, spearfishing), Dog Sports, Dance, Disability Sports; sport is the first axis, equipment type comes inside each sport page

SportScheck: top nav Damen/Herren/Kinder/Ausruestung/Sportarten/Marken; Sportarten A-Z (Badminton, Bergsteigen, Klettern, Ski, Tauchen etc.); Ausruestung lists by sport (Ski: helmets, goggles, skis, gloves, poles, protectors; Laufen: glasses, gloves, watches, headlamps, bags)
Amazon Sports and Outdoors node: fetch returned only product listings (agility hurdles, cones, treadmill pad, sleeping pad); no category tree visible so used only to show mixed training-gear listings

Wikipedia category Sports equipment by sport: about 35 subcategories each named for a sport (Badminton, Baseball, Cricket, Cue sports, Golf, Skiing, Tennis, Water sports etc.); sport is the first axis in the reference work

Ski types by terrain (on-piste, all-mountain, freeride, freestyle, touring) with waist width in mm, sidecut radius and rocker profile as the three figures; cites Salomon and SNOW.cz; states category lines are not fixed and each maker draws them differently

Racket buying guide: six aspects (swing type, head size, frame length, profile height, weight, balance); named classes midsize/mid plus/oversize/super oversize by head area, weight bands, balance bands in cm

Badminton racket guide: balance classes head-heavy/even/head-light, weight classes 3U to 6U, flex flexible/medium/stiff, grip G4/G5; maps Yonex Astrox/Arcsaber/Nanoflare, Victor and Li-Ning families to balance; price bands
Tennis.com racquet anatomy: 300 g and 100 sq in as the dividing lines; weight, head size, string pattern (16x19, 18x20), balance in inches; player-frame vs tweener vs game-improvement

Super Sports Xebio category list: top split into sports (running, soccer, baseball, basketball, volleyball, tennis, badminton, table tennis, swimming, rugby, martial arts, golf, outdoor, snow) and then equipment type inside each sport (racket, strings, shoes, ball, bag); a second cross-sport axis lists shoes, apparel, bags, caps, socks, balls, supports

HS heading 9506 tariff tree: skis, bindings, ski equipment, sailboards, water-sport equipment, golf (clubs, balls, other), table tennis, tennis rackets, badminton and similar rackets, balls by sport, ice and roller skates, exercise apparatus, other sport; the customs tree is sport-first and then type; sports clothing and footwear excluded (Chapter 61/62/64/65)

UIAA safety standards: over 25 types of climbing and mountaineering safety equipment (ropes, helmets, harnesses, connectors, pitons, anchors, chocks, pulleys, braking devices, crash pads, avalanche shovels and probes) each with a numbered standard; standards are by equipment type not by sport grade

Alpen online store filter tree: sport first (running, soccer, baseball, basketball, volleyball, tennis, table tennis, rugby, camp, trekking), then equipment type (bat, glove, ball, spikes, wear) and then spec splits (baseball bats by hard/soft ball and composite/metal/wood; table tennis rackets shakehand/penholder, rubber types)

eBay Sporting Goods: 17 first-level groups (Boxing Martial Arts MMA, Camping Hiking, Cycling, Fishing, Fitness Running Yoga, Golf, Hunting, Indoor Games, Outdoor Sports, Team Sports, Tennis Racquet Sports, Water Sports, Winter Sports, Tactical, Wholesale Lots etc.); mixes sports with activities and with a business lot class

SidelineSwap resale home page: fetch returned only the trade-in and selling text; the Shop by Sport list (hockey, baseball, lacrosse, golf, softball, skiing, football, snowboarding, tennis) and equipment-type popular categories (bats, sticks, skates, drivers, iron sets, skis, racquets) were seen in the search excerpt of the same URL (search excerpt only)

Decathlon China: over 80 sports; per sport sub-groups such as bike/body gear/bike gear/parts/tools, fishing split lure/freshwater/sea, ski clothing/boots/skis-bindings-poles, golf clubs/balls/apparel, climbing shoes/quickdraws/chalk/harness

Decathlon India sports footwear: shoe types named by sport (running, trekking, cycling, basketball, climbing, cricket, hockey, football, tennis, badminton and squash, horse riding, skateboarding, table tennis, pool, snow)
Golf irons by player-skill and design intent: game improvement, players distance, players; category lines blur; consensus naming rather than a spec
Golf irons: hybrid irons, super game improvement, game improvement, cavity back, players distance, muscle back, players, blades; states categories overlap (cavity back is a design not a level)
Cricket bat grades 1 to 4 as willow quality tiers (grain count, blemishes); described as manufacturer and retailer convention; English vs Kashmir willow
Fishing rod power (ultra-light to heavy) and action (extra-fast to slow) as two spec scales with abbreviations such as MH Fast; technique combinations

Google product taxonomy Sporting Goods > Outdoor Recreation: 17 subcategories, 458 categories to level 7; sport-first (Boating and Water Sports, Camping and Hiking, Climbing, Cycling, Equestrian, Fishing, Golf, Hunting and Shooting, Inline and Roller Skating, Outdoor Games) with equipment types and protective apparel nested inside each sport

Google product taxonomy Sporting Goods > Athletics: 25 subcategories, 231 in total; each is a sport (American Football, Baseball and Softball, Boxing, Fencing, Field Hockey and Lacrosse, Rugby, Soccer, Tennis, Track and Field, Wrestling) with equipment (balls, bats, racquets) and Protective Gear beneath it

Google product taxonomy Sporting Goods > Exercise and Fitness: 26 subcategories, 56 in total; organised by equipment type (Cardio Machines, Weight Lifting, Yoga and Pilates, Exercise Balls, Foam Rollers) not by sport

FIE material rules: homologation compulsory for blades, points, jackets, breeches, under-plastrons, masks, gloves; 800 N fabric standard, mask bib 1600 N, glove cuff 350 N; separate rules for foil, epee and sabre
evo ski boot guide: flex index 50 to 130+ banded soft/medium/stiff/very stiff by ability; states flex is not standardized between makers; Mondopoint sizing; last width
evo wetsuit guide: thickness in mm (0.5 to 6+, written as 3/2, 4/3, 5/4/3) tied to water-temperature bands; types full suit, springsuit, long john, top, bottom, rashguard; seal types
Football boot ground types FG, SG, AG, MG, TF, IC as soleplate-to-surface codes; used as a standardised-by-convention attribute
Maker tier ladder Elite/Pro/League/Club within model silos Predator/F50/Copa; surface codes FG, AG, SG, MG, TF, IC; shows tier and ground type as attributes of a named form

Golf Heritage Society collecting categories for clubs: by era and make (Feather Ball Era long nose woods and blacksmith irons; Gutta Percha Era; Mass Produced Clubs with makers and cleek marks; Patent Clubs; Classic Clubs about 1930 to 1990) plus a separate putter and Scotty Cameron path; collectors divide by era and maker, not by club type

Smithsonian National Museum of American History Sports and Leisure: sports paper objects, leisure objects (camping vehicles and gear, video games, playing cards, sportswear, exercise equipment), toys; shows a museum does not keep a sport-first equipment tree

Wood Tennis Rackets collectors guide: contents by technological generation, grading quality versus condition, collection criteria, reference tables of makers, marks and patents; collector axes are maker, era and condition
